Figure 4 - Dynamic response assessment using dual-assay ctDNA and imaging in HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancers

David N Brown, Bill H Diplas

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

27 June, 2026




Figure 4a Density plots of imaging (T2 MRI volume and DW MRI mean ADC) and genomic (ctDNA fraction inferred from PCM and number of cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs) biomarkers across weekly measurements.




Figure 4c ctDNA dynamic tracking showing the percentage change of imaging and genomic measures from baseline across weeks 1 to 3 from patient CTMS-161.




Figure 4d Proportion of patients achieving clinically relevant response thresholds (>30% reduction, solid line; >90% reduction, dotted line) by modality (MRI, PCM, HPV) across treatment timepoints, highlighting earlier response detection with PCM or HPV assays.




Figure 4e Waterfall plots comparing the magnitude of change in tumor volume (top) versus ctDNA fraction (bottom) at week 2 on-treatment.




Figure 4f Correlation of ctDNA fraction with cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs (top) and on-treatment MRI-derived tumor volume (bottom).




Figure 4g Bar plot with confusion matrices displaying on-treatment ctDNA detection rates by assay type (PCM, HPV, Combined).
